svg.title: A02 NEW HORIZONS CRYOPHASE engineering architecture
svg.desc: Phase selection couples to signed energy exchange, while spectra enter through a separate optical/instrument branch. Equilibrium and unique bulk composition are not inferred merely from band appearance.
